title: Lantern Clue A
front: Wax trails descend toward the Root Vault.
back: The lantern was not lost. It was hidden below, on purpose.

title: Lantern Clue B
front: The candle pattern omits a final vow.
back: The shrine’s light is incomplete because one promise was never released.

title: Seal Clue A
front: The seal inscription reads: Bound by request, not punishment.
back: Whoever entered the lantern chose duty once. They may not choose it still.

title: Seal Clue B
front: A second line warns: Unbind without witness and the road forgets its way.
back: If the keeper is freed, the village will need a new path or a shared flame.

title: Key Clue A
front: The lantern latch opens only when two voices answer together.
back: The shrine demands agreement. No one player can decide alone.

title: Key Clue B
front: The keeper offers a third path: share the flame instead of hoarding it.
back: A divided light can protect the road and reveal a hidden root path beneath the hill.
